question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
-- Final query: compute share change for top 20% products
WITH us_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year, s.prod_id
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM us_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
),
qualified_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE q4_2019_sales > 0
      AND (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) * 1.0 / q4_2019_sales >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        us.prod_id,
        SUM(us.total_sales) as total_product_sales
    FROM us_sales us
    WHERE us.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
    GROUP BY us.prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_product_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_sales
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE quintile = 1
),
-- Total sales per quarter in qualified cities
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(total_sales) as total_sales
    FROM us_sales
    WHERE cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
-- Product sales per quarter in qualified cities (only top products)
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        us.prod_id,
        us.calendar_year,
        SUM(us.total_sales) as product_quarter_sales
    FROM us_sales us
    WHERE us.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
      AND us.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY us.prod_id, us.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    p.prod_id,
    p.prod_name,
    ROUND(qt_2019.total_sales, 2) as q4_2019_total,
    ROUND(pqs_2019.product_quarter_sales, 2) as q4_2019_product_sales,
    ROUND(qt_2020.total_sales, 2) as q4_2020_total,
    ROUND(pqs_2020.product_quarter_sales, 2) as q4_2020_product_sales,
    ROUND(pqs_2019.product_quarter_sales * 1.0 / qt_2019.total_sales, 10) as share_2019,
    ROUND(pqs_2020.product_quarter_sales * 1.0 / qt_2020.total_sales, 10) as share_2020,
    ROUND(pqs_2020.product_quarter_sales * 1.0 / qt_2020.total_sales - pqs_2019.product_quarter_sales * 1.0 / qt_2019.total_sales, 10) as share_change
FROM top_products tp
JOIN products p ON tp.prod_id = p.prod_id
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2019 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2019.prod_id AND pqs_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2020 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2020.prod_id AND pqs_2020.calendar_year = 2020
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2019 ON qt_2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2020 ON qt_2020.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY share_change DESC
